name: @561-group/ruinfold
description: Ruinfold: a browser-based 3D hack-and-slash MMORPG over the tab EAVT world-substrate and the voidmath four-valued bilattice. The world IS its append-only trace, folded (settled) every tick; death is paraconsistent — a slain undead settles its `alive` cell to ⊤ (alive AND slain, a held situation) and rises again. Server is pure Node http (SSE + POST, zero server deps); the 3D client loads three.js in the browser from a CDN import-map.

scripts.test: node tests/prove-combat.mjs && node tests/prove-undeath.mjs && node tests/prove-deaths.mjs && node tests/prove-abilities.mjs && node tests/prove-quests.mjs && node tests/prove-economy.mjs && node tests/prove-systems.mjs
